author: ravikatiyar162
description:
OrderStatusCard
A visually polished and animated card component to display a process timeline, such as an order completion status. It is built to be highly reusable, responsive, and theme-adaptive, leveraging shadcn/ui conventions and framer-motion for smooth animations.
